# Chopper Buildout Agent Memory

## Authoring Invariants (apply to every JSON review)

- **A file in `procedures.include` (PE/PI) must NOT also appear in `files.include` (FE/FI).** PI declares `PROC_TRIM` intent (drop everything in the file except the named procs); FI declares `FULL_COPY` intent (keep the file verbatim). Listing the same file in both is contradictory authoring — under R1 ordered overlay the last layer wins, so the result depends on declared layer order rather than intent. Same-layer overlap surfaces as `VW-09 fi-pi-overlap` (see `technical_docs/DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.md`); cross-layer overlap surfaces as `VW-21 layer-shadowed`. **Authoring rule: pick exactly one of FI or PI per file.**
- **A path emitted by F3 (`<stage>.tcl` / `<stage>.stack` from `flow_actions`) must NOT also appear in `files.include`.** F3 generation is a `GENERATED` treatment; FI is a `FULL_COPY` treatment. The compiler refuses the collision and raises `ChopperError` (exit 3) with `"F3 generated path '<path>' collides with an existing file decision; rename the stage or drop the colliding files.* entry"` (see `compiler/merge_service.py::_register_generated_stage_files`). **Authoring rule: rename the stage or drop the colliding FI entry — never both.**

## Current Focus

- **2026-05-22 Tokenizer P-01a extension — `{" "}` quote-space-quote false PE-02 fix.** Real Tcl `regsub -all { \s+} $ADDITIONAL_LIBS {" "} ADDITIONAL_LIBS` tripped a false `PE-02 unbalanced-braces`. Root cause: in `{" "}` the first `"` (prefix `{`) is suppressed as literal by the existing `{`-peek-back exception, but the intervening SPACE flushes that literal word (`word_start=-1`), so the second `"` (prefix = space, a word-boundary char) wrongly OPENS a quoted word that then swallows the closing `}` → phantom `unclosed_braces`. Fix in [`src/chopper/parser/tokenizer.py`](../../src/chopper/parser/tokenizer.py): track brace LEVELS that began with `{"` in a new `data_quote_brace_levels: set[int]`. When a `"` is immediately preceded by an unescaped structural `{` (brace_depth>0), record the current `brace_depth`; the quote-opener condition additionally requires `brace_depth not in data_quote_brace_levels`, so ALL subsequent `"` inside that same brace level stay literal. The level is `.discard()`-ed in the `}` branch before the depth decrement. **Why this beats depth-aware "quote must close at opening depth" or abandon-on-`}`: those REGRESS `puts "}"` / `puts "a } b"` (lone `}` inside a genuine quoted word — depth-indistinguishable from `{" "}`). The "did this brace word start with `{\"`?" signal cleanly separates quote-bearing DATA words (regsub/string-map replacements) from SCRIPT bodies (which never start with `{\"`).** O(n), single-pass, no lookahead. Also corrected a stale docstring in `test_literal_quote_in_braced_data_word_self_recovers` (described a never-existing abandon handler). New fixture `tests/fixtures/edge_cases/parser_braced_word_quote_space_quote.tcl` (4 procs: regsub `{" "}`, `string map {" " ""}`, lone-`}`-in-quote, TW-02 `;`-in-quote). 5 new tests in `TestQuotedWords`. `tests/FIXTURE_AUDIT.md` updated (fixture row + P-01a matrix). **GOTCHA: docstring/comment containing `{ \s+}` triggers a `SyntaxWarning: invalid escape sequence '\s'` — must write `\\s` in the source.** Gates: `make check` (1439 unit, tokenizer.py 100%, total 99.54%) + `make ci` (1538 passed, 100% total coverage); ruff + mypy clean. Four must-stay shapes (`{""}`, `{"x"}`, `string map {" " ""}`, `{a "b" c}`) + TW-02 `puts "a; b"` all green. **STATUS: COMPLETE.**

- 2026-05-07 Exclude-only base JSON analysis: current architecture explicitly fixes R2 default-exclude, so a base JSON with only `files.exclude` means no source contributes keeps; live trim rebuilds an effectively empty domain except generated artifacts. Immediate spec-compliant authoring pattern is `files.include: ["**"]` plus `files.exclude: [...]`. Any runtime change to interpret exclude-only as implicit include-all would reopen R2 and requires explicit user approval plus architecture-doc-first cascade. Safer product guardrail proposal: add validation for F1 exclude-only/no keep signals to fail early or warn loudly before live trim.

## Last Completed Work (2026-04-26)

**P2 full-domain proc index (Option A):**

- **Model.** `src/chopper/core/models_parser.py::ParseResult.__post_init__` relaxed from `set(files.procs) == set(index)` to `set(files.procs) ⊆ set(index)`. The `files` view stays the surfaced subset (what the compiler operates on); `index` is now the full-domain canonical-name map (what P4 trace consults). Same-instance check uses `from_files.items()` so identity equality still holds for entries present in both.
- **Parser.** `src/chopper/parser/service.py::ParserService.run` split into:
  - **Phase 2a — surface parse.** Iterates `loaded.surface_files`, emits `PE-*` / `PW-*` / `PI-*` via `ctx.diag`, populates both `parsed_files` and `index`.
  - **Phase 2b — full-domain harvest.** New `_enumerate_domain_tcl(ctx)` BFS via `ctx.fs.list/stat/exists` (excludes `.chopper/`, returns sorted `.tcl` rel paths). Non-surfaced files parsed silently through `_noop_diagnostic` and merged via `index.setdefault(...)` so surface entries always win on canonical-name collisions.
  - `_parse_one(ctx, path, *, emit_diagnostics=True)` and `_read_with_fallback(ctx, path, sink)` updated to take an explicit sink argument.
- **Tests.**
  - `tests/unit/core/test_models.py`: invariant tests updated for the relaxed model (extra `index` keys now positively allowed).
  - `tests/integration/test_cli_e2e.py::TestFullDomainProcIndex`: two new integration tests pin the contract — `test_trace_resolves_callee_in_non_surfaced_file` (dry-run; asserts resolved edge into `helper.tcl::bar` and absence of `TW-02`) and `test_non_surfaced_file_is_not_copied` (live trim; asserts `helper.tcl` is not in trimmed output).
- **Docs.** `technical_docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` §5.2 pipeline diagram, §5.2.1 P2 narrative, and §5.4.1 Step 2 code block updated. Revision-history row added (2026-04-26).
- **Validation.** Full regression: **880 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed** (17.60s). The two skips are the `gh issue create` `tests/unit/scripts/` cases that require a `#!/bin/sh` stub and skip on Windows; they pass on Linux/macOS CI.

## Key Architectural Invariants (verified this pass)

- **Critical Principle #7** holds: trace is reporting-only. Full-domain index makes `dependency_graph.json` truthful (resolved edge → actual `defined_in`) but never copies a traced-only proc.
- **Domain boundary respected.** Phase 2b walk via `ctx.fs` rooted at `domain_root`, excludes `.chopper/`; files outside `domain_root` never read.
- **Determinism preserved.** `_enumerate_domain_tcl` returns sorted list; `setdefault` makes surface-vs-harvest collision behaviour deterministic (surface always wins).
- **Compiler unaffected.** Compiler reads only `parsed.files`; the wider `index` does not perturb F1/F2/F3 decisions.
